title: The OpenAI Agents SDK
intro: Agent, Runner, tools, handoffs, guardrails, traces — the lightest framework in the course, in one project.

steps.title: The primitives
steps.body:
```python
from agents import Agent, Runner, trace, function_tool

sales_agent1 = Agent(name=..., instructions=..., model=...)
result = Runner.run_streamed(sales_agent1, input="Write a cold sales email")
```

Any Python function under `@function_tool` becomes a tool. Wrap runs in `trace("name")` and every model call, tool call, and handoff is inspectable at platform.openai.com/traces.

steps.title: The SDR project
steps.body: Three differently-styled sales agents draft **in parallel** under one trace; a **picker agent** chooses the best; a tool sends it (SendGrid). Then the upgrade: an **emailer agent** (with a `handoff_description`) takes over formatting-and-sending entirely — via `handoffs=[emailer_agent]`.

points.label: Tool
points.note: Consultation: the caller invokes, gets the result, stays in charge of the run.

points.label: Handoff
points.note: Delegation: control TRANSFERS — the receiving agent owns the conversation from here.

points.label: Trace
points.note: The whole tree — parallel drafts, the pick, the handoff — visible as one trace.

steps.title: Guardrails and structure
steps.body:
- **`@input_guardrail`**: a guardrail agent judges the request and returns `GuardrailFunctionOutput` — tripping BEFORE the expensive pipeline runs (the lab blocks requests containing personal names).
- **Structured outputs**: set a Pydantic `output_type` and get parsed objects back, not prose.
- **Any model**: `OpenAIChatCompletionsModel` points agents at any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — DeepSeek, Gemini, local.

steps.title: Where it sits
steps.body:
The lightest of the course's four frameworks: minimal abstraction, explicit control flow — best when *you* orchestrate and agents are competent workers. Teams-of-roles and explicit state machines are the next two weeks.

> [!warn] The lab's ordering is deliberate: the guardrail exists before the pipeline scales. Autonomy without a guardrail is an incident report waiting to happen.

recap:
**Agent + Runner + tools + handoffs + guardrails + traces.**

- Tool = consult; handoff = delegate the conversation.
- Guardrails are agents about agents, tripping before cost.
- Pydantic output_type for structure; any OpenAI-compatible model.
- Never run agents without traces.
